notes: kuna-fixes cases: classes Vineflower 1.12.0 fails on that a kuna fix decompiles. Each runs in compat and in default mode on the fixture's base map plus `options`; maintained by tests/jvm/kuna_fix_case.py, read by regen.py.

cases.summary: every `new DiamondLib(..)`/`new DiamondBox()` whose expected type is a `DiamondLib<..>`/`DiamondBox<..>` (static and instance fields, a local, returns, an assignment, arguments, a ternary operand, a generic class's field) is written `new C<>(..)`, so the lambdas get their `Object[]` parameters back and the class recompiles to identical bytecode; `Object OBJECT = new DiamondBox()` and the non-generic `DiamondPlain` stay as they are
`objects` and `shapes`, which pass `factory::create` on a `Factory<?>`/`ShapeFactory<?>` receiver to a generic `map`, decompile to their source; the failure comments and bytecode listings are gone
`create` and `attempt`, whose `catch (Throwable)` handlers start with `if (!flag)`, decompile to their source; `read`, a try-with-resources on a nullable resource, is still rebuilt as one
